definition: Hand-written truth for bench/fixtures/go/shop. caller -> callee is an edge when running the caller's own body calls the callee with no other repo function in between: a closure belongs to the function around it, a package-level initialiser to the package, `go` and `defer` are calls, a conversion is not. A callee written once under several build constraints has an edge to each variant (#2, #3 in source order). Ids are import path, colon, Name or Type.Method. A leading ~ stands for example.com/shop/. The module compiles (go vet ./...); tests/test_go_golden.py scores ripple against this file, and the compiler-derived static call edges (go/types over linux and windows and the flagged and gadgetb tags) agree with it except the three named in allowed_missing.

allowed_missing.~pricing:Ptr -> ~internal/money:Sum: pricing/ptr.go uses Go 1.26 new(expr), which tree-sitter-go 0.25 cannot parse: the file is listed as unparsable and the calls of the function that holds it are unresolved
allowed_missing.~cart:UseStrategy -> ~pricing:Percent.Ap: Strategy is declared as a Percent under !fast and as a pricing.Rule under fast: which one wins is not known
allowed_missing.~inventory:UseStack -> ~inventory:Item.C: it comes from Stack[T].Pop, whose result is the type parameter T
